prompt: Ticking one checkbox in the issue table lags. It looks like every row on the page redraws.

truth.summary: IssueTable passes each PureComponent IssueRow a new inline onToggle arrow on every render, so the shallow prop comparison always fails and all 100 rows re-render when one selection changes.

referenceAnswer.cause: IssueTable passes an inline onToggle arrow to each PureComponent row, so its shallow comparison always sees a new function.

decoyAnswers.cause: IssueRow is a PureComponent, which is slower than React.memo.
selectedIds is a new array after every toggle.

genieEvidence.notes: react_render_causes names prop onToggle (exact, unstable) on every row. The adaptive render budget covers only about 30 of 100 rows (mountedUnknown 70); the probe raises the budget to its maximum. Every row's behaviour evidence reports 2 subtree host mutations, which are React 18 Update flags from the new onChange/onClick closures, not DOM changes.
